question: Does full rational twist7-torsion yield the explicit degree17 source endomorphism (pi+1)/7, with generic identities and scalar action353?

claims.text: Exact degree17 map, conjugate norm and Frobenius-plus-one identities are checked generically.
All823 source points have action353/inverse415; all833 twist points map to7-torsion, with kernel17/image49.
Known endomorphism theory and scalar action are not unknown-log recovery, orbit-folding speed, IC improvement, novelty or a NIST result.
